pages.text: Left click to lash: the lash is a real simulated rope and only sections sweeping through a target fast enough deal damage - faster hurts more, each target is hit once per lash with halved follow-up damage. Hold right click for 2 seconds and release to slam the ground for a shockwave. Parts: tough handle + large plate + bowstring, all standard Tinkers parts you can already pattern and cast.
